claims.text: Get fresh scan data
claims.note: The toolbar button fetches the latest scan data TurfRad holds (see request-scan-data/tile/2 for what it does not do).

claims.text: Fetch the latest TurfRad scan data now rather than waiting for the next automatic retrieval.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (request-scan-data/tile/2); docs/text-corrections.md §22 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: Request a new TurfRad scan rather than waiting for one.

claims.text: A course that has fallen behind TurfRad does not have to wait for the next automatic retrieval.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (request-scan-data/summary/1); docs/text-corrections.md §22 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: A stale course is not something you have to wait out.

claims.text: Ask for the latest scan data TurfRad holds, and reload when it is ready.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (request-scan-data/summary/2); docs/text-corrections.md §22 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: Request a new TurfRad scan, and reload when it lands.

claims.text: Toolbar
claims.note: The button is in the main Spatial Adjust toolbar, to the right of the pushed-today counter.

claims.text: The Spatial Adjust dashboard, at /spatialadjust.
claims.note: The route is /spatialadjust. Reworded from dashboard-overview/where/1.

claims.text: No dialog open.
claims.note: The guide starts on the dashboard with no dialog open; every dialog here opens only on a user action. Reworded from dashboard-overview/where/1.

claims.text: A Spatial Adjust account on a site with TurfRad scan data.
claims.note: Reworded from dashboard-overview/before/1.

claims.text: When a scan is not current, what you see depends on the calculation option.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (request-scan-data/before/1); docs/text-corrections.md §25 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: When a scan is not current the calculation still runs — it runs on a modelled value carried forward from the last scan and the weather since, shown in grey italics.

claims.text: Under Option 2 the calculation still runs, on a value modeled forward from the last scan and the weather since, and the reading is shown in gray italics with a calculator icon.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (request-scan-data/before/1); docs/text-corrections.md §25 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines. Wording updated after the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review (American spelling, station and sprinkler terms); the fact is unchanged.

claims.text: Under Option 1 the station shows a dash in % Adj. and is left out of the push until a current scan arrives.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (request-scan-data/before/1); docs/text-corrections.md §25 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.

claims.text: Read the scan date before anything else
claims.note: The scan date is on every station row.

claims.text: Look at the scan dates beside the station names in the table.
claims.note: The scan date sits beside the station name on every station row. Reworded from request-scan-data/1/1, request-scan-data/1/2, request-scan-data/1/4.

claims.text: Each row shows the date its reading was captured, and the dates are today.
claims.note: A scan is current when its date is today in the course's time zone. Reworded from request-scan-data/1/2, request-scan-data/1/3.

claims.text: If one date is old, that is one station.
claims.note: One stale row is one station. Reworded from request-scan-data/1/3.

claims.text: If every date is old, no setting will fix it, so go on to request the data.
claims.note: The dates are TurfRad's recorded scan dates, which no setting changes; requesting scan data helps only if TurfRad holds something newer. Reworded from request-scan-data/1/3, request-scan-data/tile/2.

claims.text: Scan dates sit beside the station name in the table.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: Request the latest scan
claims.note: The request is made from the toolbar button.

claims.text: Select [[Request latest scan data]], the circular-arrow button in the toolbar.
claims.note: The tooltip is Request latest scan data (en-us.json:454). Reworded from request-scan-data/2/2, request-scan-data/2/1.

claims.text: The button dims and its icon spins while the request runs.
claims.note: Only the button changes while the request runs: it dims and its icon spins (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:52, :57). Reworded from request-scan-data/3/3.

claims.text: If you cannot find it, look between the pushed-today counter and the gear.
claims.note: From the pushed-today counter the order is separator, this button, the Announcements bullhorn, the Settings gear. Reworded from request-scan-data/2/5, request-scan-data/2/2.

claims.text: It fetches only what TurfRad already holds, and it does not order a new scan.
claims.note: It fetches what TurfRad already holds and does not order a scan. Reworded from request-scan-data/2/3, request-scan-data/2/4.

claims.text: Request latest scan data, between the pushed-today counter and the gear.
claims.note: Figure caption. From the counter the order is: separator, this button, the Announcements bullhorn, the Settings gear. The bullhorn also sits between this button and the gear (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:62-65).

claims.text: Note. This button and Reload Data are two different things.
claims.note: The scan button is in the toolbar. Reload Data appears only on the banner.

claims.text: One asks for new data; the other brings data that has already arrived into the page.
claims.note: "New data" means whatever TurfRad holds that Spatial Adjust has not yet retrieved. Reload Data re-fetches the dashboard's data from the server.

claims.text: It queues, it does not block
claims.note: The endpoint returns 202 Accepted, and the server starts the retrieval without waiting for it.

claims.text: Look for the [[Request Queued]] message.
claims.note: The toast is titled Request Queued (en-us.json:453). Reworded from request-scan-data/3/2, request-scan-data/3/1.

claims.text: It says retrieval may take several minutes and that you will be notified when it is ready.
claims.note: The toast reads that retrieval may take several minutes and that the user will be notified when it is ready (en-us.json:457). Reworded from request-scan-data/3/2.

claims.text: If [[Request Failed]] shows instead, the request did not queue.
claims.note: A failed request at once shows Request Failed (en-us.json:452). Reworded from request-scan-data/5/2.

claims.text: Select the button again.
claims.note: The failure text asks the user to try again (en-us.json:487). Reworded from request-scan-data/5/2.

claims.text: You can keep reading the table while it runs, and the retrieval finishes even if you leave the page.
claims.note: The retrieval runs on the server and finishes whether or not the page is open. Reworded from request-scan-data/3/3.

claims.text: A queued request confirms immediately; the data arrives later.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: Reload when the banner appears
claims.note: The banner carries the Reload Data button.

claims.text: On the banner, select [[Reload Data]].
claims.note: The banner carries the Reload Data button (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:182-195). Reworded from request-scan-data/4/5, request-scan-data/4/3.

claims.text: The dashboard loads the new readings, and every suggestion recalculates against them.
claims.note: Reload Data re-fetches all of the dashboard's data and each suggestion is recalculated as it loads. Reworded from request-scan-data/4/3.

claims.text: If the banner has gone, [[Dismiss]] only hides it.
claims.note: Dismiss only hides the banner. Reworded from request-scan-data/4/4.

claims.text: The next time the dashboard loads its data, it picks the new scan up.
claims.note: The data is picked up whenever the dashboard loads its data again. Reworded from request-scan-data/4/7.

claims.text: The banner appears whether or not TurfRad had a newer scan, so the numbers can come back unchanged.
claims.note: The banner says so whether or not TurfRad had a newer scan. Reworded from request-scan-data/4/2.

claims.text: The banner offers Reload Data or Dismiss.
claims.note: Figure caption. The buttons are "Reload Data" (SPATIAL_ADJUST.RELOAD_DATA) and "Dismiss" (SPATIAL_ADJUST.DISMISS).

claims.text: Careful. Dismissing is not declining.
claims.note: Dismiss has no effect on the data.

claims.text: The next reload picks the new scan up.
claims.note: After Dismiss there is no Reload Data button until the next request. The data is picked up whenever the dashboard loads its data again: opening or refreshing the page, saving a settings change, or changing station factors (sa-dashboard.component.ts:262-278).

claims.text: If scans still do not arrive
claims.note: The step now covers scans that never arrive, which is what the diagnostics TurfRad panel explains. Reworded from request-scan-data/5/3.

claims.text: Hold Shift + Alt and click the Spatial Adjust logo.
claims.note: The handler opens the dialog only with Shift and Alt held (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:293-299). Reworded from station-zero/5/2.

claims.text: The diagnostics dialog reports TurfRad access, scan data and the last scan date.
claims.note: The TurfRad panel lists org access, scan data and the last scan date. Reworded from request-scan-data/5/3, station-zero/5/4.

claims.text: If access or scan data is missing, that explains scans that never arrive, and the cause is not in your settings.
claims.note: The panel's checks explain a course whose scans never arrive. They do not explain a request that will not queue: the server fails the request only when the site has no Spatial Adjust update record or the call itself fails, and Diagnostics shows neither. Reworded from request-scan-data/5/3.

claims.text: The dialog opens a second or so after the page loads, and also when Lynx data has failed to load.
claims.note: Corrected rule: docs/text-corrections.md section 27. Reworded from station-zero/5/3.

claims.text: Diagnostics: TurfRad access, scan data, last scan date.
claims.note: Figure caption. The Diagnostics dialog opens only on a Shift+Alt click on the Spatial Adjust logo, and only once a Lynx course is loaded or Lynx has failed to load (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:4, sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:293-299). No guide step says how to open it. Its labels are hard-coded English (sa-diagnostics-dlg.component.html:22-89).

claims.text: You know the toolbar can fetch the latest scan data from TurfRad, not only display what was last retrieved.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (request-scan-data/verify/1); docs/text-corrections.md §22 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: You know the toolbar can request a scan, not only display the last one.

claims.text: You can tell Request latest scan data from Reload Data.
claims.note: Achievable from the guide.

claims.text: You know Dismiss leaves the dashboard on the data it already had.
claims.note: Achievable from the guide.
